title: Typography / Typeface

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Choose a type family with a coherent voice across roles and languages, so readers encounter continuity without losing the needs of a particular script.
strategic_value: Plex’s related subfamilies and multilingual specimens can connect IBM’s technical and human character across its global communications.
demonstration: The long webpage combines film states, subfamily and weight specimens, an interactive tester, feature tiles, monospaced comparisons, language lists and non-Latin specimens.
practical_value: Compare Plex subfamilies, features and script support before selecting a face for content and language.

content_islands.name: Typeface introduction
content_islands.spec: Open with the black title, introductory statement, section links, a blue video state and resource cards.

content_islands.name: Family and weights
content_islands.spec: Show the IBM film poster and the subfamily tabs above a weight specimen ranging from Thin to Bold with italics.

content_islands.name: Tester and features
content_islands.spec: Place the captured Heavy boxes tester above six feature tiles covering ligatures, alternates, fractions, currency and arrows.

content_islands.name: Spacing comparison
content_islands.spec: Compare Mono and Sans with the word Quill over individual glyph cells.

content_islands.name: Language range
content_islands.spec: Follow the language list with large specimens for Arabic, Traditional Chinese, Cyrillic, Devanagari, Greek, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean and Thai.

content_islands.name: Math and stewardship
content_islands.spec: Close with a mathematical specimen, license and distribution links, design-team credits, awards and contact guidance.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says Plex reflects IBM’s roots, brand spirit, beliefs and design principles.
reference_purposes.Expression: Related family weights, feature tiles and multilingual specimens demonstrate Plex’s typographic character.
reference_purposes.Application: The page distinguishes family styles, language coverage and typographic features for selection.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
